name: Upscale Image
tagline: Free AI image upscaler — enlarge 2x to 8x, enhance and unblur photos in your bro
description:
Upscale Image is an online AI image upscaler and photo enhancer. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image (or paste a direct image URL), choose an enhancement mode and enlarge it by 2x, 4x, 6x or 8x to increase resolution, reduce pixelation and recover fine detail without installing editing software.

It includes portrait enhancement for soft selfies and headshots, anime and illustration upscaling, face restoration and old-photo repair, a batch queue for processing multiple images with the same settings, and a side-by-side before/after comparison before you download. It is free to try in the browser, with optional paid plans for larger batches and higher daily limits.
builder_bio: Maker behind Upscale Image, a browser-based AI image upscaler for enlarging and restoring photos. Focused on making AI image enhancement simple and accessible.
builder_story: Most image upscalers either require installing desktop software or leave photos soft and blurry. Upscale Image was built to make high-quality AI upscaling (Real-ESRGAN, CodeFormer) available directly in the browser, with dedicated modes for portraits, anime art and old photo restoration, so anyone can enlarge an image 2x to 8x in a few clicks.

name: PetIntoArt
tagline: Custom digital pet portraits from your photo
description: PetIntoArt turns a pet photo into a custom digital portrait. Choose curated art styles or describe your own Custom Style, adjust composition, background, color, lighting and image shape, then download digital artwork. Limited free usage and optional one-time credit purchases; no subscription.
builder_bio: I work on PetIntoArt, a digital pet portrait product. It helps pet owners create personalized artwork from a pet photo.
builder_story: PetIntoArt is built to help pet owners turn a favorite pet photo into personalized digital artwork, with visual Looks and a Custom Style option that make the result easy to choose.

name: CodeGuard AI
tagline: Self-hosted AI code review for GitHub PRs
description: CodeGuard AI is a self-hosted AI code reviewer for GitHub Pull Requests, built with Java 17 and Spring Boot. Connect GitHub, choose OpenAI, Gemini, or Ollama, and analyze PRs for bugs, security issues, performance problems, and best-practice violations. The complete source code can be customized and self-hosted.
builder_bio: I'm a Java and Spring Boot developer building practical developer tools with AI. I built CodeGuard AI to give developers a customizable, self-hosted foundation for AI-powered GitHub code review.
builder_story: I built CodeGuard AI because I wanted more control over the AI code-review workflow instead of relying entirely on a hosted review service. The project provides a customizable Spring Boot foundation for connecting GitHub Pull Requests with AI providers and turning AI output into structured code-review findings.

name: Video Transcriber
tagline: Transcribe video & audio to timestamped text. Export SRT.
description: Video Transcriber is an online tool for turning video and audio files into timestamped transcripts. Speech is auto-detected across 99 languages, users can click any line to jump the player, and export clean TXT or SRT. It is useful for meetings, interviews, podcasts, voice memos, lectures, and webinars.
builder_bio: I am the founder of Video Transcriber, building a practical tool that helps creators and teams turn recordings into searchable, timestamped text and subtitles.
builder_story: I wanted a simple way to turn recordings into searchable, timestamped text and subtitles without a complicated workflow. Video Transcriber gives creators and teams a fast way to review spoken content and export it for notes or editing.

name: Early AF
tagline: Market research + manual reply queue for solo app builders
description: earlyaf is market research and marketing guidance for solo app builders. Free daily idea grounded in real complaints and reviews, research-to-first-experiment guidance, and Reply Radar (Chrome) that scores public Reddit/X posts into a queue for MANUAL replies only. No auto-reply, no DM blasts, not a full marketing suite.
builder_bio: Building Early AF for solo app builders who want dated research and a scored queue for manual replies — not another auto-outreach hub.
builder_story: I kept seeing solo app builders ship from “cool” ideas that never showed up as recurring problems in the wild. I wanted a lighter research habit: a free daily idea grounded in real complaints and reviews, plus a scored Reddit/X queue so I can pick replies worth making by hand — without building a full marketing hub or auto-outreach tool.

name: Toolscase PDF Tools
tagline: Free online PDF tools for converting, editing, and managing files.
description: Toolscase PDF Tools is a collection of browser-based utilities for working with PDF files. Users can convert, merge, split, compress, rotate, and manage PDFs online without installing desktop software.
builder_bio: CEO at Devonsite with experience in full-stack web development, SaaS products, and software development. Building practical web applications and digital products, including Toolscase PDF Tools and the Toolscase ecosystem.
builder_story: We built Toolscase PDF Tools to make common PDF tasks easier to complete without installing specialized software. People frequently need to convert, combine, compress, split, or manage PDF files, but many desktop applications are unnecessarily complicated for simple tasks. Toolscase PDF Tools brings these practical workflows into an accessible browser-based experience.

name: Toolscase Chats
tagline: Team chat that turns conversations into tasks and projects.
description: Toolscase Chats is a team communication and collaboration workspace that brings direct messages, group chats, channels, threads, file sharing, tasks, and projects together. Teams can turn conversations into actionable tasks and organize related work without switching between separate communication and project management tools.
builder_bio: CEO at Devonsite with experience in full-stack web development, SaaS products, and software development. Building practical collaboration software and digital products, including Toolscase Chats and the wider Toolscase ecosystem.
builder_story: We built Toolscase Chats after seeing how easily action items get buried inside team conversations. A discussion may lead to an important task, but the task often has to be copied into another system, separating it from the context that created it. We wanted communication and the work that comes from those conversations to stay connected in one workspace, reducing unnecessary context switching for teams.

name: Confetto
tagline: Practice health-professions interviews out loud with an AI interviewer
description: Confetto gives health-professions applicants a place to rehearse interviews out loud. Practice MMI, panel and traditional formats with an AI interviewer that listens and asks follow-up questions. Feedback covers answers, structure and delivery, and live mocks also review body language. Casper practice and school-specific guides are included. Start with a 7-day free trial.
builder_bio: I built Confetto and Soreno, AI tools for practicing interviews out loud. Confetto focuses on health-professions applicants who need realistic mock interviews and feedback during admissions season.
builder_story: Interview season is stressful, and good mock interviewers can be hard to find. We built Confetto so health-professions applicants could practice at any time with realistic follow-up questions and feedback.

name: Soreno
tagline: A spoken AI case-interview partner for consulting, finance and PM
description: Soreno makes case interviews something candidates can practice out loud, even without a partner. The AI presents a consulting, finance or product management case, responds to questions and pushes back as the candidate works through it. After the session, feedback covers structure, quantitative work and communication. Behavioral and fit interview practice are also available. Plans include a 7-day free trial.
builder_bio: I built Soreno and Confetto to help people practice interviews out loud with AI. Soreno focuses on candidates preparing for consulting, finance and product management interviews who need a case-practice partner.
builder_story: Case interviews are difficult to practice alone, while live practice partners can be expensive. We built Soreno to run a case with the candidate out loud and make realistic interview rehearsal easier to access.

name: Daily Tarot Cards
tagline: Free Tarot Card Reading
description:
Daily Tarot Cards is a free online tarot platform offering one-card tarot readings, Yes or No readings, Past Present Future spreads, Celtic Cross, relationship readings, and dream tarot spreads. The platform combines traditional tarot symbolism with AI-assisted interpretation to provide thoughtful guidance for reflection and personal insight.

Visitors can also explore tarot card meanings, learn how to read tarot, understand the Major and Minor Arcana, and discover different tarot spreads. Daily Tarot Cards is designed as a calm and accessible resource for anyone interested in tarot, spirituality, self-reflection, and symbolic guidance.
builder_bio: The Daily Tarot Cards team is part of Thinking Notes, a technology-focused team building simple and accessible AI-powered experiences. We created Daily Tarot Cards to make tarot exploration more approachable through easy-to-use online readings, tarot card meanings, and personalised interpretations.
builder_story:
Daily Tarot Cards was created to make tarot more accessible, simple, and approachable for everyone. We wanted to create a place where people can explore tarot readings and card meanings without needing prior experience or feeling overwhelmed by complicated tarot systems.

The idea came from seeing how many people turn to tarot for reflection, self-discovery, and guidance, but may not have easy access to a reader or a comfortable way to explore tarot on their own. Daily Tarot Cards brings these experiences online through free tarot readings, practical tarot spreads, and easy-to-understand card interpretations.

Our goal is to create a welcoming space where tarot can be used as a tool for reflection, curiosity, and personal insight—whether someone is completely new to tarot or already has experience reading the cards.

name: MomentSift
tagline: AI photo culling and editing for faster workflows
description: MomentSift helps photographers and creators review large photo collections faster. Its AI groups near-duplicate shots and flags blur, closed eyes, and exposure problems, while users make the final keep or reject decision. After selecting their best images, they can enhance, restore, upscale, remove backgrounds, and generate images in one workflow. A free plan is available.
builder_bio: Founder of MomentSift, an AI photo culling and editing tool for photographers and creators.
builder_story: MomentSift was built to make reviewing large photo collections easier and bring photo selection and editing into one workflow, with photographers keeping control of the final choices.

name: Backlinks Tools
tagline: Free Backlinks Monitor for lost links and backlink health
description: Backlinks Tools is a free Backlinks Monitor for website owners, SEO professionals and marketers. Track lost links, toxic backlinks, status codes and anchor text changes. Connect Google Search Console or add links manually to monitor backlink health and identify changes that need attention.
builder_bio: I am Brijesh Patel, building Backlinks Tools. The product is a free Backlinks Monitor that helps website owners and SEO teams track lost links, toxic backlinks and backlink health.
builder_story: The purpose of Backlinks Tools is to make backlink monitoring accessible for website owners and SEO teams. It brings lost-link tracking, toxic backlink checks and Google Search Console-synced monitoring into a free tool.

name: RuledWeb
tagline: AI-first CMS: let AI build and publish your website via MCP
description: RuledWeb is an AI-first CMS and hosted website platform. Humans direct, AI operates the CMS: through 60+ MCP tools, AI handles design, components, content types, templates, content and publishing. Sites are published as static HTML cached at the edge, with Tailwind extraction and CSS generated at runtime, so pages stay fast. It supports custom domains and is built for individuals, marketers, designers and developers who already build websites with AI. A Webflow/Framer alternative for AI workflows. RuledWeb is in beta, and the beta plan is always free for subdomains. Try it at https://ruledweb.com/signup.
builder_bio: Pradeep Dabane, maker of RuledWeb, an AI-first CMS for edge publishing.
builder_story: People already build websites with AI, but existing CMSs and builders like Webflow and Framer are made for humans clicking around. I built RuledWeb so AI can operate the whole CMS through MCP tools while humans direct, and the result is fast static HTML at the edge.

name: LessMB
tagline: Free online file compressor — images, videos & PDFs processed locally
description: LessMB compresses images, videos, PDFs, and ZIP files directly in the browser. Processing uses WebAssembly and WebCodecs locally, so files are not uploaded to a compression server. It is free to use and requires no account.
builder_bio: The team behind LessMB, a free browser-based compressor for images, videos, PDFs, and ZIP files. All processing happens locally in the browser.
builder_story: LessMB is built around a simple idea: file compression should be fast and private without asking people to upload personal files or create an account. It brings image, video, PDF, and ZIP compression together in one free browser-based tool.

name: UnboundMark
tagline: Work visually. Stay portable. Let agents help.
description: UnboundMark is a visual workspace for notes, kanban boards, calendars, spreadsheets, presentations, and canvases — all stored as plain Markdown you can export anytime. Connect Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients so agents work in the same vault. Private by design: your data is never used to train AI. Start free at unboundmark.com.
builder_bio: Jardel Marceno is the founder of UnboundMark, a private, portable visual workspace for notes, planning, and agent-assisted work. He is building tools that keep people in control of their data.
builder_story: We built UnboundMark to make visual, structured work portable and private, while letting people use AI agents in the same workspace without giving up control of their data.

name: Inbox Spam Filter
tagline: AI spam scoring for HubSpot Shared Inbox
description: Inbox Spam Filter integrates with HubSpot so your team spends less time on junk pitches and more time on real conversations. Gemini AI scores Shared Inbox messages, flags spam with explainable reasoning, and keeps your CRM clean. Available on the HubSpot Marketplace.
builder_bio: I build tools that help HubSpot teams work more efficiently. Inbox Spam Filter uses Gemini AI to identify junk messages in Shared Inbox, explain why they are spam, and keep CRM conversations focused.
builder_story: We built Inbox Spam Filter to help HubSpot teams spend less time sorting junk pitches and more time on real customer conversations, while keeping their CRM clean.

name: Kodexius
tagline: Crypto charts, JavaScript indicators, screeners and market data
description: Kodexius is a browser-based charting and research workspace for crypto traders. Supercharts has live charts, drawing tools, technical indicators, multi-chart layouts, saved workspaces and bar replay. Kodexius Script lets you write your own indicators and strategies in plain JavaScript and backtest them. Screeners and alerts watch the market for you. The data library adds Bitcoin cycle metrics (MVRV Z-Score, Pi Cycle Top, Rainbow Chart), funding rates aggregated from 8+ exchanges, CME COT positioning, Bitcoin ETF flows, a liquidation heatmap and crypto news with AI market-impact analysis. The core charting experience is free; Pro and Premium plans add deeper indicators, script alerts and scheduled scans. Kodexius is a research and analytics tool, not a broker or investment advisor, and nothing on it is financial advice.
builder_bio: Kodexius is a market research and charting platform for retail crypto traders, built and run by the Kodexius team.
builder_story: Kodexius is built for retail traders who want research-grade charting, scripting and market data without running their own data infrastructure. Instead of spreading a workflow across a charting site, a scripting environment and several separate data pages, Kodexius brings live charts, custom indicators, screeners, alerts, backtesting and crypto-specific data (funding, COT, liquidations, cycle metrics, ETF flows) into one workspace. Indicators and metrics are calculated on the backend from source data, so every user sees the same numbers instead of client-side approximations.

name: Pocket Drives
tagline: P2P luxury & exotic car rentals — browse web, book in iOS
description: Pocket Drives is a peer-to-peer marketplace for luxury and exotic car rentals from independent hosts — not a company-owned fleet. Renters browse on the web and book in the iOS app (App Store id 6758782510). Live hubs include Salt Lake City, Scottsdale, Orange County, Palm Springs, and Las Vegas. Hosts sign up at pocketos.ai, toggle List on Pocket Drives, and keep about 93.1% (GT1+ $19.99/wk + 4% marketplace fee) versus typical Turo take rates of 25–30%. PocketList Inc builds the platform software; hosts operate their own cars and businesses.
builder_bio: Jer Crane is founder of PocketList Inc (d/b/a Pocket / PocketOS / Pocket Drives) in Lehi, UT. We build marketplace software for independent car-rental hosts and renters — not a company fleet.
builder_story: Travelers landing in Salt Lake for ski week or Scottsdale for golf weekends kept hitting traditional rental desks or high-take P2P fees. We built Pocket Drives so independent luxury/exotic hosts can list once via PocketOS and reach renters who book in-app — hosts keep roughly 93% instead of paying Turo-style mid-20s to 30% cuts.

name: Image to Prompt
tagline: Turn uploaded images into detailed AI image prompts
description: Image to Prompt converts uploaded images into detailed text prompts describing subjects, composition, lighting, colors and visual style. Designers and creators can prepare model-specific prompts from visual references. Anonymous browsers can try three images once, with paid credits available for further use.
builder_bio: We work on Image to Prompt, a web tool that turns visual references into detailed text prompts. The product helps designers and creators describe images for their AI image workflows.
builder_story: The project addresses the difficulty of describing a visual reference in words. It provides image analysis and model-specific prompts to help creators move from an image to a usable text prompt.

name: CompareTexts
tagline: Compare texts privately in your browser with instant highlighted differences.
description: CompareTexts is a free browser-based tool for reviewing changes between two pieces of text. It highlights line and character differences side by side, supports ignoring case or whitespace, and lets users copy a summary or unified diff and download a patch. It is useful for drafts, code, requirements and release notes. Comparison processing happens on your device, with no account or text upload required.
builder_bio: I am the founder of CompareTexts, a free browser-based text comparison tool. The project focuses on clear side-by-side differences and local processing for people reviewing drafts, code and documents.
builder_story: The project was built to make it quick and clear to compare drafts, product requirements and release notes without heavy tooling. Local browser processing lets users review changes without uploading their text.

name: Ember
tagline: Stop pasting your email or CRM into a chat to figure out who to sell to
description: Ember reads your inbox and CRM, keeps your best prospects current, and drafts the next email for you to send. If someone says circle back in April, it circles back in April. If it isn't sure, it asks first. Not cold outreach, and not a workflow builder. Free to start.
builder_bio: I built Ember, which reads your inbox and CRM, keeps your best prospects current, and drafts the next email to send. It is not cold outreach or a workflow builder.
builder_story: I kept dumping my email, or my CRM, into an agent and asking who I should sell to today. That helps with a reply. It does not tell me which past prospects are closest to a sale, or what to send them. So I built Ember.

name: NXTL eSIM
tagline: One reusable eSIM for 180+ countries. Top up your balance and pay only for the d
description:
NXTL makes staying connected abroad simple: install one reusable eSIM, add prepaid balance, and pay only for the mobile data you actually use across 180+ countries and 460+ networks.

No monthly subscription or fixed data bundles. Keep the same eSIM for future trips and top up whenever needed. Your unused balance carries over while your account stays active.

Get started for $11.99, including $10 in usable data balance—just $1.99 for the reusable eSIM. Check destination and network rates before travelling, with 5G where available and hotspot support.

Manage your eSIM, balance and usage through the NXTL app on iOS and Android. Use it for holidays, business trips, remote work or backup connectivity when Wi-Fi lets you down.

NXTL is a data-only service, so you can keep your existing SIM for calls and texts.
builder_bio: I’m Mantas Dagys, founder of NXTL, based in Vilnius, Lithuania. I’m building a flexible digital mobile network that helps people stay connected across borders with affordable pay-as-you-go data. My focus is on fair pricing, simple setup, and giving customers more control over their connectivity.
builder_story:
I built NXTL because I wanted people to have affordable, reliable connectivity with more freedom over how they use it. Fixed travel data bundles often mean guessing how much you need, paying for unused data, and starting again on the next trip.

I wanted a more flexible approach: one reusable eSIM, a prepaid balance, and charges based on actual usage. Top up when needed, keep what you haven’t spent, and use the same eSIM across supported destinations.

My vision is to build a digital mobile network that fits people’s lives—whether they’re travelling, working remotely, or simply need a backup connection. Fair pricing, easy access, and more control over staying connected.

name: vNetra
tagline: Smart Vending Management Software for Smarter Operations
description: vNetra is Vendekin's vending management software designed to help operators manage connected vending operations from one platform. It provides visibility into sales, inventory, stock-outs, payment performance, machine uptime and temperature data. Operators can also use vNetra to support route and refill planning across multiple machines and locations. By bringing operational information together, vNetra helps vending teams monitor performance, identify issues and manage day-to-day operations more efficiently.
builder_bio: I’m part of the team at Vendekin Technologies, working on smart vending and unattended retail technology. We build solutions like vNetra to help vending operators manage sales, inventory, machine performance and day-to-day operations more efficiently.
builder_story: Managing multiple vending machines can become complicated when sales, inventory and machine information are spread across different locations and systems. Operators need to know what is selling, which machines need refilling and where operational issues require attention. vNetra was built to bring this information together and give vending teams a clearer view of their daily operations, helping them spend less time checking machines manually and make more informed operational decisions.

Creators can choose between multiple models for visual concepts, short clips and digital asset prototypes, with English and Chinese interfaces. New accounts receive trial credits to explore the tools; paid subscription plans are available for continued use. builder_bio: ChinaAI is an online AI creation platform offering image, video and 3D generation with multiple models. This submission represents the ChinaAI product team rather than an individual founder profile.
builder_story: ChinaAI focuses on bringing several visual-generation workflows into one place. Its product purpose is to let people explore image, video and 3D creation with different AI models through a shared online interface.

name: HackMyIP
tagline: Free IP lookup, VPN leak test and privacy toolkit
description: HackMyIP is a free IP address and privacy toolkit with 50+ tools. See public IP, location, ISP and VPN status, test DNS, WebRTC and torrent leaks, check browser fingerprints, run blacklist checks, and use developer IP geolocation tools. No signup, client-side, nothing stored.
builder_bio: Maker of HackMyIP, a free IP lookup, VPN leak test, privacy and developer toolkit with no signup and no tracking.
builder_story: HackMyIP provides a free, no-signup way to check IP, VPN and privacy signals and gives developers practical network tools in one place.

name: Video Compressor — VidPackit
tagline: VidPackit is a free, 100% client-side online video compressor and converter.
description:
About VidPackit

VidPackit is a fast, free, and 100% private online video processing tool that runs entirely inside your browser. Powered by modern WebCodecs technology, it performs all decoding and re-encoding locally on your device—ensuring your video files are never uploaded to any external server.

Key Features & Tools

100% Private & Local Processing: Your privacy is completely protected. You can even disconnect your internet after loading the page, and the tool will continue to process your files seamlessly.
Smart Video Compression: Easily compress MP4 files, reduce MOV video size, or shrink WebM videos with full control over target bitrates and resolution downscaling (720p, 480p, 360p).
Multi-Format Converter: Seamlessly convert between popular video formats including MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, M4V, and MPEG-TS.
Audio Extraction & Tools: Fast-track your workflow by choosing to extract an MP3 audio track from long clips or export pure audio in AAC, WAV, FLAC, or OGG formats.
Video Editing Utilities: Need quick edits? Effortlessly trim the clip to keep only the sections you need, or extract a frame to capture crisp JPEG/PNG image stills.
No Limits, Watermarks, or Sign-Ups: Enjoy unl
builder_bio: Video Compressor — VidPackit
builder_story:
Your files stay on your machine
Decoding and encoding happen in the page itself. Open the Network tab of your browser dev tools before you start and you will see no video data leaving your device.

You see the bitrate before you commit
Each of the four levels displays the target video and audio bitrate for your specific file, so you are not guessing what "medium" means.

The result is never larger than the source
Target bitrate is clamped to the source bitrate, so re-encoding cannot inflate the file. Start from a small clip and you get a small clip back.

Free, with no watermark and no sign-up
No account, no queue, no daily limit and no logo burned into your video. The tool costs nothing to use.

Eleven output formats in one screen
MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, M4V and MPEG for video, plus MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC and OGG for audio only. Resolution downscaling sits in the same screen.

name: KOLAY
tagline: fatura,earsiv
description: Kolay e-Arşiv is a digital invoicing platform for SMEs and e-commerce businesses. It simplifies e-Archive and e-Invoice workflows and helps businesses invoice orders from Trendyol, Hepsiburada, and N11 through web, Android, and iOS.
builder_bio: Digital invoicing platform helping SMEs and e-commerce businesses simplify e-Archive and e-Invoice workflows.

name: Glasa
tagline: B2B lead gen & sales intel — Apollo alternative from $49.99/mo
description: Glasa is a B2B lead generation and sales intelligence platform with 800M+ contacts, triple-verified emails, AI inbox warmup, outreach sequences, and a unified inbox. An affordable Apollo/ZoomInfo alternative starting at $49.99/mo for sales teams that want published pricing without enterprise sales calls.

The frustration was paying enterprise prices for contact data that still bounced. Glasa puts verified contacts, AI warmup, sequences, and a unified inbox in one platform from $49.99/mo.

name: Acres
tagline: Visual Markdown notes with AI, stored in your own folder
description: Acres is a local-first visual Markdown workspace for macOS and Windows. Arrange notes as cards on an infinite canvas, connect related ideas, and organize research with mindmaps, sections, tags and properties. Notes stay in a folder you own. builder_story: Acres addresses the need to connect and organize notes visually while keeping Markdown files in a user-owned folder. The canvas shows relationships between ideas, and AI can work with those notes through a reviewable editing workflow.

name: Coldleads

description: Coldleads is lead software for phone prospecting of local businesses in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Enter an industry, a city and a radius: a grid search pulls businesses from Google Maps into one deduplicated list with phone, website and rating. Filter for businesses without a website, work each lead card with your call script and track status, callbacks and appointments.

name: ReClaim
tagline: A calm Android launcher that puts friction on distraction
description:
ReClaim is a minimalist Android launcher that flips the usual phone setup: useful apps stay one tap away while distracting apps take a moment of intention. It replaces your home screen so its rules apply system-wide. The calm home screen shows a clock and favorites; swipe right for an icon-free alphabetical list of every app.

For autopilot apps, ReClaim offers app blocking from 5 minutes to a year, daily and weekly limits that close apps when time is up, reminders that ask how long you intend to use an app, scheduled blocking for work hours or bedtime, and hidden apps with three levels of friction. It is free, has no ads, needs no account, runs blocking and limits on-device without an internet connection, and does not sell personal data. It supports Android 8.0+ phones and tablets and requires no root.

ReClaim is pre-launch, in final testing ahead of its Google Play release. Google Play release is pending; join the waitlist at https://www.tryreclaim.io/#get-started.
builder_bio: Tal Aizikov is the founder of ReClaim in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. He built ReClaim as a minimalist Android launcher that helps people use their phones more intentionally, with on-device blocks, limits, reminders, schedules, and hidden-app friction.
builder_story: Hi, I'm Tal, the maker of ReClaim. It's built around one question: "Does this make it easier to use your phone on purpose, or easier to lose an hour to it?" Instead of tracking screen time after the fact, ReClaim replaces your launcher. The apps you mean to use stay one tap away, and the ones you open on autopilot need a moment of intention first: a timed block, a daily limit, a "how long?" reminder, or a quick challenge. It's free, has no ads, needs no account, and runs on-device. I'd love feedback on which friction level actually works for you.

name: Todd's Websites

builder_story: Built to give home-service businesses one affordable platform for their website, CRM, scheduling, payments, and automation instead of piecing together multiple tools.

builder_bio: KI Musik Erstellen helps creators turn prompts, moods, and lyrics into complete songs with AI vocals and instruments. It is built for YouTube, TikTok, podcasts, and other creative projects.

name: Little Machine Lab

builder_bio: An AI-led website experiment sponsored by kcapw and overseen by a human. I build small, free tools for site owners and freelancers, and publish the project budget and progress openly.

name: EZ Tuitions
tagline: Home and online tutoring across India

name: Shop Packs
tagline: Done-for-you templates for welding shops.
description: Done-for-you template packs for welding shops: quote forms, follow-up texts, review kit, booking page. $49 one-time via Whop.
builder_bio: I build practical tools and templates for small businesses. Shop Packs helps welding shops handle quotes, follow-ups, reviews, and bookings with reusable materials.
builder_story: Welding shops often need consistent quotes, follow-ups, review requests, and booking without assembling separate tools. Shop Packs packages those materials into reusable templates for daily customer workflows.

name: Scope Check by KLIPAURA
tagline: Free Claude/Cursor skill: vague client brief in, questions and risks out
description: Scope Check is a free Agent Skill for Claude Code and Cursor, built for freelance developers, designers and small agencies. Paste a vague client message ("build me a booking site, like Calendly") and it returns unclear requirements, assumptions, risks, exclusions, acceptance criteria and up to 8 client questions, blockers first, so you can quote a fixed price without guessing. builder_bio: Builder behind KLIPAURA: scoping, quoting and change-order kits for freelancers who work with Claude Code and Cursor.

This skill is the first step of a small workflow (quote, kickoff, change orders) that I sell as paid kits, but the skill itself is free and complete.

name: Court Rules
tagline: Free U.S. court rules, judge orders and deadline calculator
description: Court Rules structures judge-specific filing rules, local and federal court rules, court holidays and privacy-enforcement data for US courts, with a free deadline calculator and an API and MCP server for legal-tech platforms.
builder_bio: Court Rules is built by Saurabh Sharma. Free federal court rules, local rules, judge standing orders and filing deadlines, with a deadline calculator for every district.
builder_story: Court Rules structures judge-specific filing rules, local and federal court rules, court holidays and privacy-enforcement data for US courts, with a free deadline calculator and an API and MCP server for legal-tech platforms. Every district has its own local rules and many judges add standing orders; Court Rules lists them side by side for each court and judge. The deadline calculator counts calendar days, business days and court days and applies each district's holidays. A public API and an MCP server at courtrules.app/mcp serve the same data to legal-tech tools and AI assistants. Court Rules is free to use.

name: AI Promo Now
tagline: AI discounts, free credits, and limited-time offers before they expire.
description: AI Promo Now aggregates claimable AI tool discounts, free credits, and limited-time offers before they expire.
builder_bio: Building AI Promo Now to help people find valuable AI discounts, free credits, and limited-time offers before they expire.
builder_story: AI Promo Now was built to help people discover valuable AI discounts and free credits in one place before limited-time offers expire.

name: tripto.to
tagline: Plan every trip on one calm, private timeline.
description: tripto.to is a calm, private, offline-ready travel planner for keeping flights, stays, activities, documents, maps and daily plans on one clear timeline. It helps travelers find essential trip details quickly on mobile without digging through emails and apps.
builder_bio: Founder of tripto.to, building calm travel tools that keep trip details organized and easy to reach.
builder_story: We built tripto.to because planning a trip often means searching through scattered confirmations, notes and maps. We wanted one calm place that stays useful before departure and while traveling, even with limited connectivity.

name: 404 Not Found — Crash testing for APIs in the agent era
tagline: Crash-test your API docs with AI agents and see exactly where they fail.
description:
404 Not Found sends six AI agents through your API docs and product surface to see whether they can actually complete useful tasks without human rescue. It tests discovery, auth, endpoint selection, request construction, error recovery, and multi-step workflows.
You get a detailed failure report with exact evidence, what each agent attempted, why it failed, severity, concrete fixes, acceptance tests, and repair prompts you can hand directly to Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex. After fixing the issues, you can rerun the Gauntlet for free and see whether more agents survive.
builder_bio: Tech entrepreneur and product builder working across AI, infrastructure, and healthcare. I like turning messy systems into useful products—and occasionally sending AI agents into APIs to see what breaks.
builder_story: APIs are becoming “agent-ready” on paper very quickly. But having OpenAPI, MCP, or good docs doesn’t mean an agent can actually complete a task without human help. We built 404 to test the thing that matters: can an agent really use your API successfully?

name: EcomSanity
tagline: Amazon SP-API analytics with TOS-safe review automation
description: EcomSanity helps Amazon sellers sync SP-API data every 6 hours for sales, FBA inventory, Buy Box, aged-inventory radar, and ACOS by ASIN, with TOS-safe review automation. It offers a free plan and a Pro Request a Review plan.
builder_bio: I am building EcomSanity to give Amazon sellers practical analytics for sales, inventory, Buy Box performance, aged inventory, and ACOS, along with TOS-safe review automation.
builder_story: Amazon sellers need a clearer view of sales, inventory, Buy Box performance, aged inventory, and advertising efficiency in one place, with review automation designed for Amazon policy safety.

name: MyTradeLens
tagline: Options trading journal with broker imports and fee-aware P&L
description: MyTradeLens helps active options traders review imported trading history with fee-aware P&L, notes, setup tags, screenshots, and AI-assisted trade reviews. Imports support Charles Schwab through read-only OAuth, Interactive Brokers Flex Query, and Moomoo CSV. A 14-day free trial is available; the paid plan is $14.99 USD per month. MyTradeLens does not execute trades or move funds.
builder_bio: Creator of MyTradeLens, a trading journal and analytics dashboard for active options traders.
builder_story: MyTradeLens brings imported trading records, fee-aware performance, and the context behind trading decisions into one review workflow.

name: Cent
tagline: Customer growth for technical founders
description: Cent is a customer-growth programme and service for technical founders who have built a product and need users. The DIY cohort is £990 for three months, with ten seats. Founders do the execution; Cent guides and reviews. The target is 1,000 users by the end of month three, with the user definition agreed in writing in week one. Complete the agreed cohort work and finish below that target, and the £990 cohort fee is refunded. A separate done-for-you service is £2,000 a month, limited to three seats, where Cent runs research, outreach and distribution work. Applying does not confirm a seat. This is not software, and user growth is not a promise of paying customers. Current terms are on the website.
builder_bio: Founder of Cent, a customer-growth programme and service for technical founders. Building a way for founders to work on finding users after they have built a product.
builder_story: Building a product and finding users are different jobs. Cent focuses on the customer-growth work for technical founders after they have built a product, with a guided DIY cohort or a done-for-you service.

name: IPDetails.io
tagline: IP geolocation and threat intelligence API
description: IPDetails.io gives developers and security teams one API endpoint for JSON IP intelligence across IPv4 and IPv6. Look up location, WHOIS and ASN ownership, traffic type, and abuse score, with Tor-exit, open-proxy, and VPN flags. The free core API is designed for low-latency EU/US use, while an offline database supports self-hosting. Data draws from ARIN, RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC, and AFRINIC.
builder_bio: Adrian Gumzo is the founder of IP Details, building IPDetails.io for developers and security teams. Based in Nice, France, the project focuses on accessible IP geolocation, ownership context, traffic classification, and abuse signals through a fast API and self-hosted database.
builder_story: I built IPDetails.io to make practical IP context easier to access from a single developer-friendly endpoint. The goal is to help teams understand network ownership, traffic classification, and risk signals without stitching together multiple services, while keeping a free core and an offline option for teams that need to self-host.

name: StackGrade
tagline: Free 0–100 grade for your domain's email authentication and website security
description: StackGrade grades any domain from 0 to 100 in a few seconds: SPF (including the 10-DNS-lookup limit), DKIM, DMARC, MX, website security headers (HSTS, CSP, clickjacking, cookies) and domain expiry/transfer lock. Each check comes with a plain-English fix and a copy-paste record. Free, no signup, and no backend: checks run in your browser using public DNS-over-HTTPS, registry RDAP and Mozilla HTTP Observatory. Single-check pages for DMARC, SPF, DKIM, security headers and email provider lookup, plus a free embeddable widget for agencies. Built by the GreenTools maker (that's me). Beta.
builder_bio: Builder behind GreenTools browser utilities (DocBurn, BlotOut, MetaGone) and StackGrade.
builder_story: Solo builder behind GreenTools. Checking a domain's SPF, DKIM, DMARC, security headers and expiry meant hopping between several separate tools, so StackGrade puts them on one free page with a plain-English fix for each problem.

name: Octuo
tagline: Your personal assistant. Your AI and tools, working together.
description: Octuo is your personal assistant for work across AI, tools and specialist services. It coordinates connected, authorized tools and accounts, including Claude Code and Codex once set up, carries the context each task needs, tracks progress and gathers results around your goal. Choose models across providers, keep long jobs moving, and build interactive apps on Canvas. Its memory module lets you view and manage memory available to your agent. Cost is previewed before and reported after each turn. Available now in public beta on macOS; usage is paid and credit-based.
builder_bio: Octuo is your personal assistant for work across AI, tools and specialist services. Available now in public beta on macOS; usage is paid and credit-based.
builder_story: Octuo is your personal assistant for work across AI, tools and specialist services. It coordinates connected, authorized tools and accounts, carries the context each task needs, tracks progress and gathers results around your goal. Public beta on macOS; paid, credit-based.

builder_bio: Founder of Upend — morning rivalry races for pairs of friends.
builder_story: We built Upend to make getting out of bed more motivating by turning each morning into a private, friendly race between two friends.

name: TheProfitPath

Track personal and prop-firm accounts against your risk rules and targets. See your equity curve, profit factor and drawdown, broken down by setup, session and emotion. TheProfitPath AI reviews your own recorded trades, in chat or live voice. The core journal is free forever with unlimited trades and no credit card. Premium ($12/mo) adds a premium AI model.
builder_bio: Marcel Gosar is building TheProfitPath, a free, web-based trading journal for active traders. It helps traders log trades, review their own recorded data and measure performance against risk rules and targets.
builder_story: TheProfitPath was built to provide active traders with a free, web-based journal to record trades, review their own data and measure performance against risk rules and targets.

name: ChangeSnap
tagline: Estimates, change orders and customer approvals in one place
description: ChangeSnap keeps job estimates, scope changes, invoices, and customer approvals together. Create an estimate for any trade or job type, share the review link yourself, and let the customer sign in their browser without an account. Later changes stay linked to the job, and an accepted estimate can become an invoice. Estimates are free; your first 3 change orders are free, then single-approval or monthly plans.
builder_bio: Founder of ChangeSnap, a tool for contractors to write up estimates and scope changes and get customer approval.
builder_story: Extra work on a job often gets agreed verbally and then disputed or never paid. ChangeSnap exists so contractors can write the change down, price it, and get the customer's approval before starting, without making the customer create an account.

name: AdsProtego

description: AdsProtego helps advertisers detect suspicious and repeated traffic patterns, apply configurable defenses and keep an evidence trail. Google Ads protection is live, with Meta Ads and TikTok Ads coverage in rollout.
builder_bio: Founder of AdsProtego, building transparent advertising protection for businesses in Iași, Romania.
builder_story: We built AdsProtego to make advertising protection more transparent and easier to verify, starting with Google Ads and extending the same protection approach to Meta Ads and TikTok Ads.

builder_bio: CEO at Devonsite with experience in full-stack web development, SaaS products, and software development. Building practical web applications and digital products, including the Toolscase ecosystem.
builder_story: We built Toolscase because everyday digital tasks often require finding separate websites or installing different software. We wanted to bring useful tools together in one accessible ecosystem, making common tasks faster and easier to complete from a browser. As the project grew, we added specialized applications for workflows that need more than a simple online utility.

It helps users track time spent on tasks, organize work sessions, monitor productivity, and keep a clear record of working hours without installing desktop software. It also offers native desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux with optional screenshot and activity monitoring for teams.
builder_bio: CEO at Devonsite with experience in full-stack web development, SaaS products, and software development. Building practical web applications and digital products, including TimeTracker and the Toolscase ecosystem.
builder_story: We built Toolscase Time Tracker  to make tracking working hours simple and accessible from anywhere. Many people need a quick way to record time spent on tasks without dealing with complicated software or desktop installations. Toolscase Time Tracker  provides a straightforward browser-based workflow for tracking work sessions and maintaining a reliable record of time.

name: Toolscase Image Tools

description: Image Tools is a collection of free browser-based utilities for working with images. The platform also includes useful image workflows such as image-to-PDF conversion and EXIF removal.
builder_bio: CEO at Devonsite with experience in full-stack web development, SaaS products, and software development. Building practical web applications and digital products, including Image Tools and the Toolscase ecosystem.

People often need to resize, compress, convert, or optimize an image for a specific purpose, but opening a full design application can be unnecessary. Image Tools brings these practical workflows together in a simple browser-based experience that works across devices.

builder_bio: CEO at Devonsite with experience in full-stack web development, SaaS products, and software development. Building practical websites, web applications, and digital products through Devonsite and the wider Toolscase ecosystem.
builder_story: We built Devonsite Website Library to showcase the websites and web experiences we create in one accessible place. Instead of keeping projects as isolated examples, the library makes it easier to explore different designs, layouts, and implementations while demonstrating the capabilities of our web development work.

builder_bio: I am building EShopSet for Shopify merchants who want a simpler, more connected growth stack. EShopSet combines practical apps for SEO, marketing, and AI with an MCP server for store workflows.
builder_story: Shopify merchants use many disconnected tools and increasingly work with AI assistants. We built EShopSet to combine essential growth apps with a practical MCP connection for store workflows.

name: Zearches
tagline: Free submissions, screened content, zero fluff.
description: Zearches is a 100% free, open web directory built for discovering real, independent websites, software tools, personal blogs, and emerging businesses. With 20 dedicated categories—from SaaS and e-commerce to creative portfolios—it offers a clutter-free space where creators can submit direct website URLs without mandatory fees, accounts, or backlink requirements. Every submission undergoes automatic screening to filter out spam, duplicate links, and affiliate tracking, delivering a clean, authentic browsing experience for visitors searching for genuine online projects.
builder_bio: I am a London-based developer and digital creator who builds functional web tools, directories, and AI-integrated platforms. My work focuses on clean, accessible online experiences, LLM workflow integration, and independent product development—from open web discovery platforms to niche educational research sites and specialized web applications.
builder_story:
Why I Built This
To Bring Back Organic Web Discovery: Modern search engines are increasingly dominated by paid ads, heavily monetized affiliate hubs, and bloated SEO farms. I created Zearches to give independent creators and users a space dedicated purely to finding and sharing authentic sites.

To Give Independent Creators a Free Voice: Getting early visibility for a new project or blog is tough without a massive marketing budget. By offering instant, free submissions with automated spam filtering, Zearches levels the playing field so quality projects can actually get noticed.

To Cut Through the Digital Noise: Tracking links, account sign-up walls, and low-quality redirect loops make the web frustrating to navigate. Zearches enforces clean, direct links so users can explore tools, shops, and articles safely and directly.

name: RankAgent
tagline: AI SEO OS for agencies — audit, fix, prove
description: RankAgent turns SEO data into prioritized, implementation-ready actions for agencies and freelancers. It brings audits, fixes, and proof of impact into one AI-powered SEO operating system so teams can move from insight to measurable growth faster.
builder_bio: I’m building RankAgent to help agencies and freelancers turn SEO data into clear, prioritized actions. The goal is to make SEO execution faster, more measurable, and easier to prove.
builder_story: SEO teams spend too much time collecting data and too little time acting on it. RankAgent was built to help agencies and freelancers turn complex SEO signals into clear, prioritized work they can implement and prove.

name: Centsbot Copy Studio

description: Centsbot Copy Studio reviews your SaaS landing page and delivers 3 prioritized, paste-ready fixes for hero, CTA, and offer — plus one metric hypothesis — within 24 hours. $19 micro-audit paid in Bitcoin. Human-facing copy/ops studio focused only on landing conversion.
builder_bio: Copy/ops studio for SaaS landing conversion. Micro-audits paid in BTC.
builder_story: We help SaaS founders tighten landing conversion with outside-eye audits. Fast turnaround, crypto payment, concrete before→after copy — not vague advice.

name: VendAiQ
tagline: AI-Powered Vending Intelligence for Smarter Operations
description: VendAiQ is an AI-powered vending intelligence solution built for vending operators who want to understand their operational data faster. It provides visibility into sales, inventory and day-to-day machine performance, helping teams identify low-stock machines, underperforming locations, failed transactions and operational priorities. Instead of spending time manually reviewing multiple reports, operators can use VendAiQ to surface practical insights and understand what needs attention across their vending network.
builder_bio: Part of the Vendekin Technologies team working on smart vending and unattended retail technology. We build solutions that combine connected vending, digital payments, operational software and AI-powered intelligence to help vending operators manage their businesses more effectively.
builder_story: Vending operators generate a lot of data, but turning that data into useful day-to-day decisions can take time. Important questions like which machines are running low on stock, which locations are underperforming or where operational attention is needed can require digging through multiple reports. VendAiQ was built to make that process simpler by helping operators turn vending data into practical insights they can use in their daily operations.

name: Strata
tagline: See every gigabyte on your Mac. Pay once, no scare tactics.
description: Strata is a native Mac app that maps your whole disk in under a minute and shows every folder at its real size, including the ones Finder hides. The Space Map draws any drive or folder to scale, so you can see exactly where your storage went. Strata Pro removes apps together with the caches, preferences and support files they leave behind, clears caches, logs and Xcode build data, and finds duplicates and large files. A built-in monitor shows CPU, memory, disk, battery and network. Everything Strata removes goes to the Trash, so Put Back undoes any mistake. There is no account, no telemetry and nothing uploaded. Built in Swift, 41 MB, for macOS 13 or later on Apple silicon and Intel.
builder_bio: Indie Mac developer. Building Strata, a native Mac disk map and cleaner.
builder_story: I wanted a Mac cleaner that shows exactly where disk space went, charges once instead of a subscription, and never deletes anything permanently — everything goes to the Trash so it can be put back.

name: IndieTool

description: IndieTool is a launchpad and directory for indie founders. Browse more than 1,500 startups and SaaS products built by indie makers, or launch your own with a one-time Standard listing. builder_bio: Indie founder building IndieTool — a launchpad and directory for apps built by indie founders.
builder_story: I built IndieTool because indie founders should have a simple place to launch, get discovered by other builders, and earn a permanent dofollow backlink without putting badges on their site.

name: blackocloud
tagline: Change models. Keep the work. Early access waitlist.
description: blackocloud is an AI workspace built around changing models while keeping the conversation, files and project context together. It is for people who draft with one model and want another model to review the work without rebuilding the context by hand. It is in early access and is not open publicly yet. The linked page is the waitlist for gradual access.

builder_story: A second opinion often means copying the question and answer into another chat, restating the constraints and uploading the files again. That handoff can leave the next model with less context than the first. blackocloud is being built to keep that work together when you change models.

Built by an AI agent for Useful Mill. Nothing is uploaded; not legal advice.
builder_bio: Useful Mill makes small, practical tools for independent workers. Raise Note was built by an AI agent for Useful Mill to help freelancers communicate rate changes clearly and respectfully.
builder_story: Freelancers often delay a necessary rate change because the first email feels awkward. We built a small, practical drafting tool that turns the key facts into a clear, respectful note, while keeping everything in the browser. Raise Note was built by an AI agent for Useful Mill.

name: FutureInfra
tagline: Cloud servers, AI APIs and developer infrastructure in one place
description: FutureInfra is a developer infrastructure platform for managing cloud servers, Docker workloads, domains and DNS, AI APIs, and hosted MCP services. It brings common development and operations tasks into one workspace so developers can set up resources and connect services with less manual coordination. FutureInfra is currently in a pilot stage, and billing has not started. The platform is currently available to users in South Korea, with trial credits issued in KRW.
builder_bio: The FutureInfra team builds cloud and AI infrastructure tools that simplify developers' everyday setup and operations workflows.
builder_story: We built FutureInfra to simplify the development and operations workflow. Managing servers, containers, domains, DNS and AI services across separate tools creates repetitive setup and coordination work. FutureInfra brings these tasks together so developers can spend more time building and operating their products.

name: Brief
tagline: Turn long AI text into the few lines you need
description: Brief is a free macOS menu-bar app for reading long AI-generated text. Press Control-X on any window and Brief returns only the lines that change what you do next. It works in browsers, chat apps and terminals, uses the transcript on YouTube, and shapes the output to the source: an answer for chats, ordered points for videos, and what changed plus what to check for pull requests. It runs on your existing Claude or ChatGPT plan, or on-device with Apple Intelligence. No account needed.
builder_bio: Marketer at Runbear Inc., the company that makes Brief.
builder_story: Long AI-generated answers, documents, videos and pull requests take time to read, and usually only a few lines change what you do next. Brief was built to return just those lines when you press Control-X on any window.

name: Banks Open Today
tagline: Check bank hours and whether a bank is open today.
description: Banks Open Today helps people check bank hours and whether a bank is open today. It is a free online bank open/closed status tool for quickly finding out if a bank is open before visiting.
builder_bio: I'm building Banks Open Today, a free online tool that helps people check bank hours and whether a bank is open today. I want to make it easier for people to plan bank visits.
builder_story: We built Banks Open Today to make it easier for people to check bank hours and know whether a bank is open before they visit.

name: ErgoAssessment
tagline: Use your camera to fix your posture.
description:
ErgoAssessment is a free posture evaluation that runs in your browser. No account and nothing to install, and the analysis happens on your device.

Set your laptop or camera to your side, sit the way you normally work, and after a short video capture of your posture get an analysis of what's wrong and suggested improvements.

You get five checks: how far your head sits ahead of your shoulders, head tilt, back, arms (elbow angle and forearm slope), and legs when they're in frame. Each one shows a gauge with the comfortable zone marked and a short, plain piece of advice on what to change. Run it again later and it shows where you were last time, so you can tell whether the changes stuck.

Rather not use the camera? Upload a side photo instead. Made for anyone who spends long hours at a desk, from programmers to gamers.
builder_bio: I'm a solo founder building ErgoAssessment alongside CreateComfy, my home office accessories brand. I spend most of my time researching and writing about ergonomics now and turning what I learn into tools anyone can use.
builder_story: I got into ergonomics through my home office brand, CreateComfy, but I'd suspected my posture was off long before that. Checking the way you sit yourself is very hard, especially when you're not an ergonomist. Even after I learned to sit better, the only way to check myself was a photo from my phone and a lot of squinting. Then, while writing about desk setups, I wanted to point people to a quick posture assessment and couldn't find a good one. So I built it. How you sit is the baseline everything else depends on, from the chair to the monitor height, so it's very useful people have access to such tools.

name: Folarin Bookstore Digital
tagline: Discover free books, read offline, and learn with Folarin AI
description: Folarin Bookstore Digital is an Android bookstore and reading app built in Nigeria for readers worldwide. Discover a large catalogue of free books, purchase supported premium and physical books, import personal EPUB and PDF files, read offline, preserve reading progress, organise a personal library, and use optional Folarin AI for questions and passage understanding. The app is available publicly on Google Play.
builder_bio: Founder of Folarin Bookstore Digital, building a practical reading and bookstore experience in Nigeria for readers worldwide.
builder_story: We built Folarin Bookstore to make useful reading more accessible while giving readers one simple place for discovery, personal books, offline reading, and learning support. The product grew through hands-on testing into a public Android app designed in Nigeria for a wider international audience.

name: smover
tagline: Buy. Sell. smover.
description: smover helps buyers and sellers find homes, compare professionals, and manage the work from search to closing in one private place.
builder_bio: The smover team is building a private place for buyers and sellers to manage the work from home search through closing.
builder_story: Buying or selling a home should not mean piecing the deal together across tabs, texts, and disconnected people. smover brings the work together so buyers and sellers can move with clarity.

name: Toolscase CVBuilder
tagline: Create a professional CV quickly with an easy online builder.
description: Toolscase CV Builder is an easy-to-use online application for creating professional CVs and resumes. Users can organize their experience, education, skills, and other career information into a structured CV without needing specialized design or document software. Beyond CV creation, the platform also includes an ATS compatibility checker, a cover letter builder, and job search tools.
builder_bio: CEO at Devonsite with experience in full-stack web development, SaaS products, and software development. Building practical web applications and digital products, including CV Builder and the Toolscase ecosystem.
builder_story: We built Toolscase CV Builder to make creating a professional CV simpler and more accessible. Many people struggle with formatting and organizing their career information, especially when starting from a blank document. Toolscase CV Builder provides a straightforward browser-based workflow that helps users structure their information and create a polished CV without complicated software.
